objective: Acquire an outcome-unread large-scale liquid-hydrogen release and combustion archive, preserve its provenance, and determine whether a prospectively scored consequence-model validation is possible.

source.title: Fuel Cells and Hydrogen Joint Undertaking (FCH JU)

stage1_allowed_operations: download the exact archive without opening outcome files
verify archive byte count and MD5
list archive member paths, sizes and checksums
read only README, data dictionary, apparatus, geometry, calibration and experiment-index documents
classify member files by extension and declared channel family without parsing signal values
stage1_prohibited_operations: open or summarize pressure, mass-flow, heat-flux, concentration or thermocouple signal values
view or extract experimental videos or outcome images
select cases using observed consequence magnitude or model agreement
fit a release, dispersion, ignition, overpressure or radiation parameter
commit the raw archive or extracted signal rows

required: candidate case count and available channel families
eligibility decision for a stage-2 protocol
stage1_outputs.public_repository_content: metadata, hashes and aggregate eligibility only

stage2_freeze_requirements: exact all-eligible-case selection rule based only on metadata
explicit model applicability domain for delayed ignition, congestion and confinement
predeclared overpressure and heat-flux endpoints with uncertainty handling
fixed code hashes and no case-specific fitting
claim_boundary: Stage 1 establishes provenance and eligibility only. It cannot validate the station, a consequence distance, HyRAM, emergency response or SAGA. The campaign concerns large-scale liquid-hydrogen cloud release/combustion and may be outside the gaseous jet model domain.
